title.narrative: Transforming the financial system to support the development of sustainable energy solutions through technical assistance and investment in Madagascar

description.narrative: UNIDO under the lead of UNDP and in collaboration with UNCDF is currently developing a project document for submission to the SDG Fund addressing the creation of a strategic financial mechanism to transform the financial system of Madagascar into an integrated system, responding to the needs of the public and private sectors and guaranteeing the availability of stable financial resources for the financing of the country#s development and achievements. In the course of this programme, UNIDO will be responsible for the development of the Energy-Lab for sustainable energy, that will act as an incubator for early-stage projects. Furthermore, UNIDO will be key in starting-up the Lab and in selecting the partner that will manage the Lab.
